title: News Analysis: Amid the Chargers' chaos, one thing is certain: Justin Herbert won't be traded

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: News Analysis: Amid the Chargers' chaos, one thing is certain: Justin Herbert won't be traded
sources.description: The Chargers are in desperate need of a reboot, but trading away Justin Herbert for three first-round draft picks won't be part of the team's plans.
